Eighteen files contain the literal string `issue.created` as the event name. Three other files matched a plain text search but only because of the property access `issue.createdAt`, so I left them out:

- `tests/services/notification-service.test.ts`
- `src/app/api/export/issues/route.ts`
- `src/components/domain/issue/issue-detail.tsx`

I found no split, escaped or template-built forms of the name. `comment.created` also exists but is a different event.

**Source**
- `src/types/event.ts` defines the `"issue.created"` key in the event map.
- `src/types/activity.ts` has it in the action union.
- `src/schemas/activity.ts` and `src/schemas/webhook.ts` list it in their enums.
- `src/components/domain/activity/activity-labels.ts` maps it to the label text.
- `src/server/services/issue-service.ts` emits it, and also mentions it in a comment.
- `activity-service.ts`, `usage-service.ts`, `search-service.ts` and `webhook-service.ts` in `src/server/services/` subscribe to it.

**Tests**
- `tests/lib/event-bus.test.ts`
- `tests/server/domain-events.test.ts`
- `tests/components/activity-grouping.test.ts`
- `tests/services/activity-service.test.ts`
- `tests/services/issue-service.test.ts`

ANSWER: src/types/event.ts, src/types/activity.ts, src/schemas/activity.ts, src/schemas/webhook.ts, src/components/domain/activity/activity-labels.ts, src/server/services/issue-service.ts, src/server/services/activity-service.ts, src/server/services/usage-service.ts, src/server/services/search-service.ts, src/server/services/webhook-service.ts, tests/lib/event-bus.test.ts, tests/server/domain-events.test.ts, tests/components/activity-grouping.test.ts, tests/services/activity-service.test.ts, tests/services/issue-service.test.ts
